title: Independent verification: first two-guard reciprocal failure and complete locus
body:
PR1655 supplies a reachable two-guard reciprocal failure at target precision 15, but explicitly leaves minimum failing precision and complete earlier real-input coverage unclaimed. This independent verification establishes that **15 is the first failing target**, and gives the complete failure set at that target: **seven closed rational intervals**. The strict-contract equality endpoints are included.

Only `research/reciprocal-first-failure-audit/` is added. Status: **independent finite verification**, a downstream Section09 arithmetic result; **no new kappa** or selected-frontier change.

Two new implementations cover the fixed seed 5/8, six-bit warm-up, exact products, floor rounding and capped schedule for every real `1 <= c < 2`: an integer-significand prefix census and a separately written rational inverse-floor interval partition. They share no evaluator code and import no predecessor executable. Replay compares all 524,416 outputs byte for byte: 262,272 two-guard cells across p=1..15, plus 262,144 three-guard p15 positive-control cells. It also compares exact slacks and the complete failure locus. The finite partition argument and endpoint rules are written out in the README.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/reciprocal-first-failure-audit
```

Expected: `PASS_RECIPROCAL_FIRST_FAILURE first_p=15 intervals=7 two_guard_cells=262272 independent_partition=PASS no_new_kappa`, six passing test groups, then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Local registered replay, optimized Python 3.14 replay, read-only offline relocation, six test groups and `make selected-record-check` pass. Controls include all seven equality boundaries, three lower-guard singleton failures, seven rounding/schedule mutants, an altered output stream with unchanged receipt/digest, partition gaps, actual certificate/source corruption and occupied-output preservation. Hosted CI and the full selected cold replay remain separate; no Lean, physical-tape, root/recovery integration or all-precision positive theorem is claimed.

Assignment seed83; base `5668c25a9331334e939d538540c69d69a16a3420`. The exact source pins, three candidate tasks, scope change from the generic moment card and local claim are recorded in TASK/SOURCES. Selected-record and manuscript blobs are unchanged at refreshed main `418e40eb2572d930b58c1cf9b82b41c0fc7ee08d`. Final overlap at 06:23:52 UTC covered 460 open PRs and 323 discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings. PR1638 and PR1655 heads were rechecked unchanged. No pinned coordination issue existed, so the donor's local-claim fallback was used.

Credit **Charles Bethin (@cbethin), PR1655** at `4880c3ea0401927a5fc0215dce99feefe092d9e9` for the first interval's witness and sharp seeded guard boundary; **@ToikY, PR1638** at `394b90ee7fdaedd1f666a78a442127be3da17810` for the three-guard upper proof; **Hanson Sun (@bbMisk), PR1528**; and the retained OpenAI manuscript/classical Brent reduction. Predecessor proof/README copies preserve their notices. New work is Apache-2.0, prepared for **Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**. Both implementations are from this session, with no independent human or proof-kernel review and no subagents.
